messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] read in starting values from an external vector or file?
parts:
Hi Josh, 

I am working on a similar problem, except I need to fix parameter values in my Mplus script to certain values. Your script was very helpful and I am able to get everything to work just fine when I only feed in the same data set for each mplusObject. My question is how can I adapt your script to be able to have a different data set used for each different mplusObject? At the same time, I want to save the fscores produced from each script so I want my code to output a fscore file for each script. Sorry if this is confusing and any help is much appreciated!

Best,
Pega Davoudzadeh

parts:
Dear Pega,

The fscores make sense and will be easy.  Can you explain a bit more about the different datasets?  For example, do you have a set of fixed parameter values that you want to use for all datasets (so say you have 10 different sets of parameter values and 10 datasets, you want 10 x 10 = 100 runs)?  Or do you have a different parameter set for each data set (10 parameter sets but each matched to one dataset)?

If you can explain a bit more I should be able to get an example working for you.

Cheers,

Josh
